rebel cell]] }} The '''TX-225 GAVw "Occupier" combat assault tank''', also known as the '''TX-225 GAVw Combat Assault Tank''', the '''TX-225 GAVw "Occupier" assault tank''', the '''TX-225 GAVw Imperial tank''',{{EncyclopediaCite|The Birth of the Rebellion}} '''TX-225A Occupier tank''', or simply the '''Imperial combat assault tank''', was a track-propelled [[ground assault vehicle]] used by the [[Galactic Empire]], and operated by a [[Imperial combat assault tank commander|commander]]{{Databank|imperial-combat-assault-tank-commander|Imperial combat assault tank commanders}} and two [[Imperial combat assault tank pilot|pilots]].{{Databank|imperial-combat-assault-tank-pilots|Imperial combat assault tank pilots}} The [[tank]] had great maneuverability in tight quarters, such as the streets of occupied [[City|cities]]. Its [[laser cannon]]s could devastate enemy [[troop]]s, and the powerful [[engine]]s could transport heavy payloads. ==Characteristics== [[Rothana Heavy Engineering]]'s TX-225 GAVw assault [[tank]] was the [[Imperial Army]]'s premier light urban combat vehicle. Part of the [[TX-225 Occupier]] line, the GAVw was a rugged vehicle that could be found in mechanized [[infantry]] [[division]]s and the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Stormtrooper Corps]], where the GAVw filled a much-needed support and patrol role in the Empire's [[Order of Battle]]. The tank was typically deployed in occupied [[City|cities]] and within Imperial military facilities rather than on the front lines, and were a common sight in urban centers with high amounts of unrest. Remarkably versatile, Occupiers were capable of fighting, providing support fire, and carrying [[troop]]s and cargo with equal ease. While the GAVw possessed treads, another variant of the TX-225 was [[repulsorlift]]-equipped [[TX-225 GAVr "Occupier" combat assault tank]]. [[File:ImperialCombatAssaultTank-Fathead.png|thumb|left|300px|A profile view of an Imperial combat assault tank loaded with cargo]] Small and simple, the Occupier was 7.30 [[meter]]s long and 1.82 meters tall, and was roughly the same size of a heavy [[speeder truck]]. They had an [[armor]]ed, wedge-shaped forward crew compartment that held the three-person crew—a [[vehicle commander]], a [[driver]] and a [[gunner]]—in cramped conditions. As a result of their tracks and responsive drivetrain, the Occupier was capable of stopping, turning, and maneuvering in incredibly tight quarters. They were heavily armed for vehicles of similar class, equipped with three [[Dymek]] manufactured twin [[MK 2e/w medium laser cannon]]s, two elevating and one forward-locked, a pair of light [[blaster cannon]]s mounted forward in the reinforced bow, and a [[light repeating blaster]] that could be mounted on a pintle near the main access hatch for anti-infantry and light anti-vehicle use in tight quarters. In addition to its armament, the GAVw had a depleted [[duranium]] composite armor. The composite armor was used because air friction would undercut shield generators. It had composite armor that balanced weight with durability. A matrix of [[Quadanium steel|quadanium]]-enriched [[titanium]] interspersed with [[ceramic]] plates and phase bonded onto and elastic lattice gave the armor remarkable resilience and toughness without overtaxing the vehicles propulsion system with excess weight. It was also equipped with a Rothana Heavy Engineering–manufactured [[ADGT-1500 engine]] that boasted a maximum speed of 72 [[Kilometer per hour|kilometers per hour]] on the road and 45 kilometers per [[Standard hour|hour]] off the road, as well as close-range sensors. The cost of the GAVw was 40,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]. ==History== [[File:ImperialAssaultTank-SWCT.png|thumb|left|250px|Imperial troopers in an TX-225A Occupier tank]] [[Rothana Heavy Engineering]], a longtime supplier of armor to the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic|Republic]], specialized in ground effect and repulsorlift armored vehicles. Providing excellent vehicles, such as, the Occupier Assault Tank.''[[Star Wars Complete Vehicles, New Edition]]'' During the [[Jedha insurgency]], Imperial combat assault tanks were deployed to the [[Jedha City|Holy City]] of [[Jedha]] during the Empire's occupation of the [[desert]] [[moon]] to transport [[kyber crystal]]s. Several of [[Saw Gerrera]]'s [[Partisans]] [[Battle on Jedha|destroyed]] one combat assault tank, which belonged to the [[Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit]], and stole all of the kyber crystals that were being [[Kyber crystal container|held]] on the cargo bed. [[File:Rebel_TX-225_Occupier_tank.jpg|thumb|right|A stolen TX-225 GAVw "Occupier" combat assault tank used by the rebels.]] The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] managed to capture some combat assault tanks. As such, the [[Tatooine rebel cell]] were able to use TX-225s during the [[operations on Tatooine]]. ==Behind the scenes== The Imperial combat assault tank was created and developed for the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|film]] ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''. The tank was first revealed with the teaser trailer for ''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'', on [[April 7]], [[2016]].{{SWYouTube|2BDyeARyIkw|Rogue One: A Star Wars Story Trailer Tease}} It was later identified as "Imperial Assault [[Hovertank]]" with [[LEGO]] ''[[Star Wars]] Rogue One'' sets preview photos posted on [[Wikipedia:Amazon.com|''Amazon'']], on [[August 8]], 2016.{{WebCite|url=https://www.brothers-brick.com/2016/08/08/first-look-at-lego-star-wars-rogue-one-sets-news|text=First look at LEGO Star Wars Rogue One sets [News]|author=Malloy, Chris|date=2016-08-08|work=The Brothers Brick|archivedate=20160809153640}} However, the idea of an [[TX-225 GAVr "Occupier" combat assault tank|hovertank]] was abandoned in early stages and the former name was mistakenly used in several toy lines.{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/809975501527728128|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=@maerj2000 very early on it was a hover tank but that changed. Too late to make modifications on some early product.|nobackup=1}} Though by [[July]], 2016, the tank was still hovering.{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/the-occupation-episode-guide|text="The Occupation" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}} For the film, the vehicle was crafted from a real, functional armored vehicle, a flat bed [[Wikipedia:Alvis Stormer|Alvis Stormer]], which was partially redesigned by [[Lucasfilm]] concept artists. Additionally, the tank was operated by experienced tank drivers to avoid any damage to the set and crew members.{{WebCite|url=https://people.com/movies/virtual-reality-exclusive-go-behind-the-scenes-of-rogue-one-a-star-wars-story|text=Virtual-Reality Exclusive!
